clips.title: The story
paras: The Venture Co. Engineering Plans are mechanical schematics kept inside the goblin logging mill in Windshear Crag. Recovered by Alliance operatives, they detail the inner workings of the heavy machinery devastating the Stonetalon Mountains.

Windshear Crag is choked with smoke and logging machinery as the Venture Company strips the forests of Stonetalon. Hidden inside their lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake, these engineering blueprints lay out the exact construction, strengths, and flaws of their specialized timber-harvesting contraptions.
